// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / associated / requirements
interface Iterator {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    type Item;
    next(): Option<this.Item>;
}

// types / associated / constants
interface RegisterBlock {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    comptime const Width: uint;
    read(): [uint8; this.Width];
}

// types / associated / projections
type ItemOf<I: Iterator> = I.Item;
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
